title: Video upload and processing
purpose: Explain illustrative video platform's separate media upload/transcoding/CDN and metadata/control/completion-event paths.
alt: 비디오 원본 업로드·트랜스코딩·CDN 배포와 메타데이터 및 완료 이벤트 처리 경로
requiredChecks: Client uploads bytes directly to Original blob storage, while metadata requests go via Load balancer→API servers.
Original storage→Transcoding workers→Encoded video storage→CDN; client playback uses CDN independently from API metadata path.
Transcoding workers also emit Completion events→Completion handler, which updates both Metadata DB and Metadata cache.
API servers separately access DB/cache; completion queue contains events, not video bytes, and diagram is illustrative.
